title: MPI-SWS Doctoral Program
institution: Max Planck Institute for Software Systems (MPI-SWS)
about: MPI-SWS's doctoral program accepts applications year-round and makes decisions four times a year, based on applications received by December 31, March 31, June 30 and September 30. The next cut-off is 31 December 2026.
requirements: Applications accepted throughout the year; decisions four times a year
A submitted application stays live for approximately four months
Related programmes: cs@max planck (applications due December 31) and the Maryland Max Planck Ph.D. Program (December 20)

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: "Computer science research" → "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."
"Computer science research" → "Compare sources, viewpoints, approaches, products, or alternatives using explicit criteria and structured analytical frameworks."
